description: I realize that if you’re scouring the internet this week looking for something romantic to cook for that little Hallmark holiday this weekend, the words “pot roast” probably didn’t cross your search threshold. It’s not sexy food; nobody is writing aphrodisiac cookbooks about bottom rounds and boneless chucks. But if you ask me, it’s something better, something cozy, warm, and classic, which neither steals the show nor keeps you from enjoying it. It’s for people who long ago stopped aspiring to entertain in multi-course and completely exhausting meals (for host and guest) and turned instead to comfort foods that surprise and  on sleety winter nights. Sure, those individual gratins, galettes, microgreens and shooters of soup look elegant, but none of them have ever gotten the reaction that a massive batch of ,  or great big  with a green salad did. No dessert, frosted, layered or crimped has ever had the delighted reception of freshly baked  (dough prepared days before, shh), still on their baking sheet. Why are we pretending we have a team of line cooks at our disposal, anyway?

description: There’s a yeasted waffle recipe by Marion Cunningham that the internet has pretty declared the standard that all yeasted waffle recipes should be compared to. And it really is fantastic. I’ve totally made it. BUT the problem is Marion Cunningham’s waffle recipe is the batter is thinner and much more suitable for a regular waffle iron and not a Belgian waffle iron. This recipe, however is designed for Belgian waffle makers, with a thicker batter created by the addition of Durum flour which is finely ground Semolina flour. If you can’t find Durum flour, try using the same amount of rice flour instead, or if you can’t find that, just add the same amount all-purpose flour. It’s the Durum flour or rice flour that helps to create a super crisp waffle exterior with a tender inside so if you use all-purpose know that it won’t get super crisp on the outside (though it’ll still taste great). And if you have your act together and have prepped ahead of time, make the yeast waffle batter the night before and leave it out on the counter. The overnight fermentation really does improve the flavor. But don’t fret if you forgot. Make the batter first thing, then go shower or do some dishes. Come back in a hour and the batter will be puffy and ready to use and it’ll still taste better than any other waffle you’ve made before.

description: About six weeks ago, around 9 p.m. on a day I had consumed mostly air and maybe a slice of toast because I couldn’t for the life of me , without any warning, I wanted a slice of chocolate cake with swirls of chocolate frosting and probably some sprinkles and the sprinkles, so help them, better be rainbow. Except the word “wanted” doesn’t accurately describe the craving; it was suddenly . I needed a piece of chocolate cake so badly that I began to regret every cupcake shop I’d ever walked past and not gone in during the height of the mid-aughts cupcake craze. I regretted not licking every beater of chocolate buttercream that had ever crossed my path when I worked at a bakery in high school. And I regretted that when I asked my husband why we didn’t have any chocolate cake, he said “because you haven’t made any?” He was correct — I’d made them dinner, instead — and the great unraveling of all that had once been right and good but failed to lead me to chocolate cake continued.

ingredients:
½ cups Rolled Oats
3 whole Small Oranges, Peeled
1 whole Banana, Frozen
½ cups Plain Greek Yogurt
6 whole Ice Cubes
1 Tablespoon Honey
1 teaspoon Vanilla
description: A filling  and healthy smoothie that can easily be a full meal: a tasty and refreshing orange oatmeal smoothie!

name: Soft Pretzel Rolls
ingredients:
1 cup Milk (I Used Skim)
2 Tablespoons Butter, Cut Into Chunks
1 package (1/4 Oz. Size) Dry Active Yeast
2 Tablespoons Dark Brown Sugar
2 teaspoons Salt
3 cups All-purpose Flour
12 cups Water
¾ cups Baking Soda
2 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
¼ teaspoons Garlic Powder
1 pinch Coarse Salt, Optional For Topping
description: Chewy, buttery perfection on their own, but these make a killer panini, too!

name: Pineapple Coconut Cream Macadamia Nut Treats
ingredients:
2 cups Macadamia Nuts
½ cups Sweetened Coconut Flakes
16 ounces, weight Canned Crushed Pineapples (reserve Juices)
1 cup Cream Cheese, Softened
1 Tablespoon Dark Brown Sugar
¼ teaspoons Pure Vanilla Extract
½ teaspoons Cinnamon
2 dashes Nutmeg
1 cup Cool Whip Topping
description: No baking required! A delicious sub-tropical snack or appetizer. They’re so delicious!

name: Loaded Sweet Potato Soup
ingredients:
1 whole (5 Lb. Size) Butternut Squash
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1  Medium Onion, Diced
2  Medium Carrots, Diced
3  Large Sweet Potatoes, Peeled And Cut Into Large Cubes
8 cups Chicken Broth Or Vegetable Broth
1-½ cup Shredded Cheese Of Choice (I Used Pepper Jack)
½ cups Cooked Lean Bacon Or Pancetta, Crumbled Or Diced
3  Green Onions, Sliced (green Tops Only)
description: An easy version of a loaded baked potato soup made with nutritious sweet potatoes!

name: French Apple Cake
ingredients:
3  Baking Apples
1 cup All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Salt
½ cups Butter, At Room Temperature
⅓ cups Granulated Sugar
⅓ cups Brown Sugar
2  Large Eggs
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
3 Tablespoons Dark Rum
description: Light layers of vanilla rum cake with apple pieces scattered throughout and a bountiful layer of apple rippling through the middle.

name: Spicy Pineapple Margarita
ingredients:
2 cups Ice, Divided Use
1 sprig Fresh Mint, Leaves Removed
1 Tablespoon Rind Of Lemon/Lime - Optional
½ teaspoons Himalayan Pink Salt
¼ teaspoons Crushed Black Pepper
1 cup Pineapple Juice, Fresh Or From Concentrate
½ cups Lime Juice, Fresh Or Store Bought
½ cups White Tequila, Increase Or Decrease The Quantity As Desired
½ cups Triple Sec
1 Tablespoon Tabasco Sauce (or Any Pepper-Based Light Texture Sauce Like Tapato/Cholula/Etc)
description: The perfect combination of sweet and spice to kick start any occasion. An easy-peasy drink that can be made in no time.

name: Garlicky Spinach Chicken Bake
ingredients:
1 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breast (both Sides)
2 cloves Olive Oil As Needed For Drizzling
1 cup Salt And Pepper, to taste
4 ounces, weight Minced Garlic
¼ cups Chicken Or Vegetable Stock
4 ounces, weight Cream Cheese
1 pound Heavy Cream
¼ cups Grated Parmesan Cheese
description: Emphasis on garlicky, kids.

name: Moist Banana Walnut Muffins
ingredients:
2 cups Whole Wheat Flour
1 Tablespoon Baking Powder
1 teaspoon Salt
3 whole Eggs (large)
⅔ cups Milk
½ cups Melted Butter Or Margarine
½ cups Firmly Packed Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1-½ cup Mashed Ripe Bananas (for 1 1/2 Cups I Used 3 Whole Bananas)
½ cups Walnuts, Chopped
description: I had a few leftover bananas lying around my kitchen, so I decided to whip up some tasty banana walnut muffins this weekend. They are exceptionally moist and the walnuts add a great toothsome crunch. This recipe can have myriad variations: try using different types of nuts and seeds, or add some chocolate chips or dried fruit like raisins or cranberries.

name: 30-Minute (One-Pot) Lemon Chicken & Asparagus Couscous
ingredients:
1 Tablespoon Butter, Unsalted
2 whole Chicken Breasts
1 Tablespoon Flour
2 cloves Salt And Pepper
½ teaspoons Garlic, Chopped
1 teaspoon Paprika
1 pound Lemon Pepper Seasoning
1 cup Asparagus
1 cup Chicken Broth
1  Couscous
description: This 30-Minute (One-Pot) Lemon Chicken & Asparagus Couscous is a simple solution to your weeknight dinner. It’s not only quick and easy but also low in calories and fat. Full of lemony and garlicky goodness, it’s sure to satisfy!

name: Chickpea Tortilla Soup
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 stalks Celery, Chopped
2 whole Carrots, Chopped
1 whole Onion, Chopped
2 cans (15 Oz. Size) Chickpeas, Drained And Rinsed
1 can (15 Oz. Size) Diced Fire Roasted Tomatoes
1 can (15  Oz. Size) Stewed Tomatoes
1 cup Vegetable Broth
1 teaspoon Cumin
1 Tablespoon Chili Powder
½ teaspoons Cayenne Pepper
1 dash Sea Salt And Pepper
description: Meatless tortilla soup!  An easy recipe with only a few ingredients.  Perfect winter dinner!

name: Café au Lait French Toast
ingredients:
3 whole Eggs
¾ cups Whole Milk
¼ cups Canned Sweetened Condensed Milk
3 Tablespoons Strong Brewed Coffee
1 pinch Kosher Salt
6 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
1 loaf Challah Bread, Cut Into 12 Slices
¼ cups Powdered Sugar
2 Tablespoons Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
1 teaspoon Instant Espresso Powder
½ cups Pure Maple Syrup, For Drizzling
description: Challah French toast battered in sweetened condensed milk and dusted with cocoa espresso powder.

name: Creamed Spinach Fettuccine
ingredients:
8 ounces, weight Fettuccine Pasta
2 Tablespoons Pure Extra Virgin Olive Oil (for Cooked Pasta)
2 pinches Salt And Pepper (for Cooked Pasta)
2 Tablespoons Flat-leaf Parsley, Finely Chopped
1 whole Lemon (washed, Zest Only)
1-¼ cup Light Cream
1 teaspoon All-purpose Flour
12 ounces, weight Chopped Frozen Spinach (thawed)
1 teaspoon Black Pepper
1 cup Shaved Parmesan Cheese
description: Delicious meatless pasta meal for two in no time flat!

name: Greek Kale Quinoa Salad
ingredients:
2 cups Water
1 cup Quinoa
1 cup Baby Kale, Stems Removed
½ cups Cherry Tomatoes, Quartered
¼ cups Red Onion, Minced
2 Tablespoons Chopped Kalamata Olives
1 Tablespoon Feta Cheese, As Desired For Crumbling
2 Tablespoons Fresh Parsley, Chopped
2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil
⅛ teaspoons Lemon Juice
⅛ teaspoons Salt
description: 30-minute Greek Kale Quinoa Salad. Loaded with tons of vegetables and tossed with lemon and olive oil!

name: Easy Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
½  Yellow Onion, Diced
1 cup Diced Carrots
2 teaspoons Minced Garlic
4 cups Salt And Pepper, to taste
2  Chicken Broth
¼ teaspoons Bay Leaves
½ teaspoons Dried Rosemary
2 cups Italian Seasoning
2 cups Cooked Chicken
description: This Easy Chicken Noodle Soup is filled with tender chicken, fresh veggies, and lots of noodles.

name: Purple Potato Salad
ingredients:
2 pounds Purple Potatoes
½ cups Diced Celery
½ cups Thinly Sliced And Halved Red Radishes
¼ cups Finely Chopped Green Onions, Plus More For Garnish
1 cup Tahini, For Drizzling
2 Tablespoons FOR THE DRESSING:
2 Tablespoons Light Sour Cream
2 Tablespoons Tahini
¼ teaspoons Fresh Lemon Juice
⅛ teaspoons Fresh Chopped Dill
description: This recipe for Creamy and Light Purple Potato Salad is mayo-free, has a fresh flavor, and is so purple!

name: Loaded Baked Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients:
1 head (Large Head) Cauliflower, Cored And Broken Into Large Florets
1 cup (plus Up To 1/2 Cup More Depending On How Big The Cauliflower You Use Is) Plain Low Fat Greek Yogurt OR Sour Cream
1 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese, Divided
4 whole Green Onions, Thinly Sliced
6 slices Bacon, Cooked Crisp And Crumbled, Divided
description: All the great tastes of a loaded twice-baked potato, without all the carbs.

name: Red Chile Avocado Cream
ingredients:
1 whole Ripe Avocado
¼ teaspoons Lemon Juice Concentrate
½ teaspoons Sea Or Kosher Salt
1 whole Fresh Red Chile, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
½ cups Sour Cream
¼ cups Cream Cheese, Softened
2 dashes Your Favorite Hot Sauce
description: Great on top of tacos, burritos, enchiladas. I used this wonderful cream on the side of breaded baked chicken strips just recently and it was scrumptious!

name: Massaged Tuscan Kale and Farro Salad
ingredients:
3 cups Chopped Tuscan Kale
⅛ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil
½ cups Juiced Lemon
½ teaspoons Himalayan Pink Salt
⅛ cups Raw Pumpkin Seeds
3 Tablespoons Hempseed
¼ cups Pomegranate Seeds
½ cups Farro, Cooked Per Package Instructions
3 slices Goat Cheese
description: A quick and healthy kale salad filled with vitamins, protein and grains. Quick, fresh and wonderfully delicious!

name: Sea Salt & Dill Potato Chips
ingredients:
4 whole Russet Potatoes, Peeled
3 Tablespoons Sea Salt
2-½ Tablespoons Fresh Finely Chopped Dill
description: These are great alongside a grilled burger. Great as an afternoon snack too!

name: Asparagus Onion Ring Salad
ingredients:
1  Bunch Asparagus, Trimmed
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
10  Salt And Pepper, to taste
3 Tablespoons Onion Rings (I Used Alexia Onion Rings), Chopped
4 Tablespoons Feta Cheese
1 cup Bacon Bits
4 Tablespoons Cherry Tomatoes, Halved
description: This Asparagus Onion Ring Salad combines fresh asparagus, onion rings, cherry tomatoes, feta cheese, bacon bits, and a drizzle of balsamic dressing.

name: Rosemary Brined and Roasted Pork Loin Roast
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE BRINE:
½ cups Water
¼ cups Kosher Salt
1  Packed Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Bay Leaf
1 teaspoon Peppercorns
1 sprig Fennel Seeds
1  Fresh Rosemary
½  Lemon, Cut In Half
1 clove Onion, Roughly Chopped
2 cups Garlic, Peeled And Smashed
2 pounds Ice Cubes
4  Pork Loin Roast
1-½ pound FOR THE VEGGIES:
½  Medium Carrots
2  Baby Red Potatoes
1 teaspoon Large Onion, Cut Into Quarters
1 teaspoon Garlic Cloves, Peeled
1 teaspoon Chopped Rosemary
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
¼ teaspoons Olive Oil To Coat
description: A rosemary brined and roasted pork loin roast with carrots and potatoes. A savory, juicy pork loin roast perfect for a romantic dinner.

name: Mini Cinnamon Rolls Using Crescent Rolls
ingredients:
1 package (8-count Size) Unbaked Crescent Rolls
2 Tablespoons Butter, Melted
¼ cups Granulated Sugar
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
½ cups FOR THE ICING:
¼ teaspoons Plus 1 Tablespoon Powdered Sugar
1 Tablespoon Vanilla
description: Homemade mini cinnamon rolls are easy (and even buttery) using crescent rolls. Top them with a super simple icing for a real treat.

name: Drunken Chicken Quesadillas with Pico De Gallo
ingredients:
4  FOR THE QUESADILLAS:
2 cups Skinless, Boneless Chicken Breasts
1  Dos Equis Beer (but Any Lager Will Work!)
1 Tablespoon Lime, Juiced
1 teaspoon Chili Powder
2 Tablespoons Garlic Salt
3  Butter
2  Shallots, Diced
1  Jalapenos, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
6  Green Bell Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
16 ounces, weight Large, Flour Tortilla Shells
3  Shredded Cheese (I Used A Prepackaged Tex Mex Kind)
½  FOR THE PICO DE GALLO:
1  Large Tomatoes, Diced
½ cups White Onion, Diced
1  Jalapeno, Stem And Seeds Removed, Diced
1 teaspoon Parsley, Chopped Or As Desired
description: With pulled chicken that has slow-cooked in beer all day, these quesadillas are sure to be a huge hit. Serve them up with my homemade pico de gallo!

name: Apricot Delights
ingredients:
1-½ cup White Chocolate Morsels, Melted
¼ cups Walnut Pieces, Crushed
16 ounces, weight Whole Apricots
description: Wonderful fruity snack any time you need one!

name: Thick and Chewy Granola Bars
ingredients:
1-⅔ cup Rolled Oats
⅓ cups Almond Flour
½ teaspoons Salt
½ teaspoons Cinnamon
½ cups Granulated Sugar
2 cups To 3 Cups Dried Fruit, Chopped Nuts And/Or Coconut Flakes (I Used Nuts, Coconut, Raisins, And Chocolate Chips)
3 Tablespoons Peanut Butter (or Other Nut Butter)
6 Tablespoons Coconut Oil Or Butter, Melted
5 Tablespoons Maple Syrup
2 Tablespoons Water
description: Thick, chewy, and versatile granola recipe. Use whatever add-ins you want. Vegan, gluten-free, freezer-friendly.

name: Apple Cinnamon White Chocolate Scones
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE SCONES:
½ cups All-purpose Flour, Plus More For Kneading
1 Tablespoon Oat Flour
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
1 teaspoon Salt
2 ounces, weight Cinnamon
¼ cups Apple Chips
2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar
4 ounces, weight Brown Sugar
½ cups Cold Butter, Cut Into 8 Pieces.
1 whole White Chocolate Chips
¾ cups Egg Yolk
1 teaspoon Whole Milk
¼ cups Vanilla Extract
1 teaspoon FOR THE COATING:
½ cups Sugar
description: These delicious apple cinnamon scones have ground up apple chips inside, white chocolate chips throughout, a cinnamon sugar coating, and the perfect butterscotch drizzle topping!

name: Italian Winter Soup
ingredients:
1 quart Vegetable Stock
28 ounces, weight Canned Diced Tomatoes
1 whole Medium Onion, Chopped
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Diced Garlic
1-½ Tablespoon Italian Seasoning
4 whole Italian Sausage Links (each Link Cut Into 6 Rounds, And Rolled Into A 'meatball' Shape)
2 cups Fresh Spinach
description: Now I know this isn’t the traditional Italian winter soup with pasta but since when do I make traditional stuff here? Believe me, you won’t miss the pasta one bit. There is so much flavor in this soup. I compare it to a big plate of spaghetti with Italian sausage meatballs covered in tomato sauce. My friends, it is that tasty without the need for pasta.

name: Roasted Vegetable Quinoa
ingredients:
½ heads (Medium Size) Cauliflower (cored And Coarsely Chopped)
5 cups Broccoli Florets (coarsely Chopped)
2 whole Medium Yellow Summer Squash ( Thinly Sliced And Quartered)
½ Tablespoons Olive Oil
1 teaspoon Italian Seasoning
½ teaspoons Coarsely Ground Garlic Salt
¼ teaspoons Black Pepper
5 cloves Garlic (peeled, Finely Diced)
1 whole Medium Yellow Onion, Finely Chopped
¼ teaspoons Coarsely Ground Garlic Salt
2 cups Cooked Tri-colored Quinoa (cook According To Package Instructions)
¼ cups Shredded Parmesan
¼ teaspoons Dried Basil
¼ cups Shredded Parmesan
description: Roasted cauliflower, broccoli and squash are tossed with onions, garlic, Parmesan and tri-colored quinoa creating a hearty and flavorful dish with a ton of staying power.

name: Whole Grain Breakfast Pitas
ingredients:
3 Tablespoons FOR THE SOAKING MIXTURE:
3 Tablespoons Flax Meal
2 Tablespoons Rolled Oats
¼ cups Wheat Bran
3 cups Water, Room Temperature
1-½ teaspoon FOR THE DOUGH:
1 Tablespoon Whole Wheat Flour
3 Tablespoons Salt
1-½ Tablespoon Instant Yeast
1 Tablespoon Cooked Quinoa
1-½ cup Honey
description: Homemade whole grain breakfast pitas. Perfect for a sandwich, or the way we like them—toasted with PB&J for breakfast!

name: Ham and Leek Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients:
4 cups Thinly Sliced Potatoes
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1  Leek, Diced And Rinsed Thoroughly
1 clove (Large Size) Garlic, Peeled
3 teaspoons Fresh Herbs-I Used Rosemary And Sage
½ cups Heavy Whipping Cream
¾ teaspoons Salt
1 cup Diced Ham
¾ cups Shredded Gruyere Cheese
¾ cups Shredded Colby-jack Cheese
¼ cups Chicken Broth
description: Delicious, creamy, warm scalloped potatoes made into a meal with ham and leeks. Add Gruyere for a salty cheese hit, colby jack for creamy, melty, stringy cheese, and layer it all together topped with cream and chicken broth. This warm and creamy comfort food really hits the spot!

name: Ricotta Pear and Walnut Crostini
ingredients:
12 slices Baguette
250 grams Ricotta
2 whole Pears
40 grams Chopped Walnuts
6 Tablespoons Runny Honey
1 sprig Thyme
description: Ricotta pear and walnut crostini with honey and thyme.

name: Sweet Coconut Cauliflower Rice
ingredients:
1 head Cauliflower, Cored (1 Head Should Yield About 5 Cups Riced)
1 cup Diced Yellow Onion
1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil
1 Tablespoon Fresh Minced Garlic
¼ teaspoons Turmeric
1 teaspoon Paprika
¼ teaspoons Salt
⅛ teaspoons Black Pepper
description: Sweet Coconut Cauliflower Rice has a natural sweet flavor from coconut oil, turmeric and paprika without added sugar. It’s a great recipe for weight loss!

name: Clementine Scones
ingredients:
2 cups FOR THE SCONES:
⅓ cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Granulated Sugar
1 teaspoon Baking Powder
¼ teaspoons Baking Soda
½ cups Salt
1  Cold Unsalted Butter
½ cups Large Egg
2 whole Plain Greek Yogurt
1 cup Clementines, Washed And Zested
1 teaspoon FOR THE GLAZE:
2 Tablespoons Icing Sugar
description: A fluffy clementine scone with a sweet and tangy glaze.

name: Breakfast Banh Mi
ingredients:
1-½ cup Shredded Or Thinly Sliced Daikon Radish
1-½ cup Shredded Or Thinly Sliced Carrots
2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar
1 teaspoon Kosher Salt
¾ cups Mayonnaise
2 Tablespoons Hot Curry Powder (more Or Less To Taste)
1  Whole Wheat Baguette, Cut Into 4-equal Pieces And Then Cut In Half Lengthwise
1  Large Cucumber, Cut In Half And Then Sliced Thin
8 slices Bacon, Cooked Until Crisp
4  Eggs, Cooked To Your Liking (Double This If You Plan On 2 Eggs Per Sandwich)
1  Salt And Black Pepper
½ cups Jalapeno Pepper, Sliced
description: Breakfast Banh Mi with bacon and curry aioli: perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner!

name: Maple Cinnamon Granola
ingredients:
3 cups Old Fashioned Oats
¼ cups Ground Flax Seed
¾ cups Maple Sugar (or Honey)
½ cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil
½ cups Packed Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon Sea Salt
¾ teaspoons Cinnamon
¼ teaspoons Ginger
¾ cups Dried Cranberries (optional)
description: This homemade Maple Cinnamon Granola is a delicious combination of salty and sweet, and is versatile enough to use in a variety of recipes.

name: Lemony Quinoa and Kale Salad
ingredients:
½ cups Dry Quinoa
½ Tablespoons Olive Oil
⅓ cups Chopped Onion
1 cup Kale
3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
description: Light, bright, and oh so delicious.

name: Matcha Cupcakes
ingredients:
2-½ cups FOR THE CAKE:
½ teaspoons Cake Flour
1 teaspoon Salt
2 teaspoons Baking Soda
1-½ cup Baking Powder
2 whole Granulated Sugar
½ cups Eggs
1 Tablespoon Vegetable Oil
1 cup Vanilla Extract
¾ cups Buttermilk
1 cup Whole Milk
3 cups FOR THE MATCHA BUTTERCREAM:
2 Tablespoons Salted Butter, Cubed, At Room Temperature
2 Tablespoons Powdered Sugar
description: Fluffy vanilla cupcakes topped with matcha buttercream.

name: 10-Minute Nutella Skillet Granola
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
2 Tablespoons Honey
2 Tablespoons Nutella
1-¼ cup Old Fashioned Oats
¼ cups Pecans, Chopped
1 teaspoon Cocoa Powder
½ Tablespoons Brown Sugar
description: Super easy 10-Minute Nutella Skillet Granola. Sweet, super chocolatey, and loaded with tons of big clusters.

name: Spiced Riesling Poached Pears
ingredients:
1 bottle (750ml Size) Riesling Wine
¾ cups White Sugar
2 whole Oranges, Zested And Juiced
3 whole Cloves
3 slices (thick) Ginger
1 stick (about 5cm Or 2" Size) Cinnamon
5 whole Peppercorns
1 pinch Grated Nutmeg
6 whole Bosc Pears, Firm But Ripe
6 Tablespoons Plain Chevre
description: I think I imagined the dish to be mushy and bland, which is crazy because I love both pears and wine. When I recently found some extra homemade Riesling in the basement, the light bulb turned on: why not try my favourite sweet white wine along with some Boscs (my favourite pear)?

name: Banana Bread Doughnuts with Banana Glaze
ingredients:
1 cup FOR THE DOUGHNUTS:
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
1 teaspoon Sugar
½ teaspoons Baking Powder
½ teaspoons Salt
2 Tablespoons Cinnamon
1 whole Unsalted Butter, melted
½ cups Egg
1 teaspoon Buttermilk Or Regular Milk
¾ whole Vanilla
1 Tablespoon Ripe Banana, Mashed
1 Tablespoon FOR THE GLAZE:
¼ whole Unsalted Butter, melted
¾ cups Milk
1 pinch Ripe Banana, Mashed
1 dash Powdered Sugar
description: Easy baked banana doughnuts with an extra special banana glaze.

name: Peanut Butter Cups
ingredients:
2-½ cups Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips
1 Tablespoon Vegetable Shortening
½ cups Honey Peanut Butter
½ cups Chocolate Peanut Butter
½ cubes Cinnamon Raisin Peanut Butter
3 Tablespoons Chopped Peanuts
description: So easy to make, quick, light and very delicious, these homemade honey, chocolate and cinnamon raisin peanut butter cups are my new favorite candy! Ready in just 45 minutes.

name: Roast Chicken in Cream Sauce
ingredients:
8 whole Chicken Breast, Boneless, Skinless
1 teaspoon Cayenne Pepper
1 teaspoon Pepper
1 teaspoon Salt
2 Tablespoons Butter
2 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Minced Garlic
1 teaspoon Red Pepper Flakes
⅓ cups Sun-dried Tomatoes, Sliced Thin
1-½ cup Chicken Broth
½ cups Heavy Cream
¼ teaspoons Oregano
¼ teaspoons Thyme
½ cups Grated Parmesan Cheese
2 cups Chopped Broccoli Florets
description: Delicious roast chicken in a beautiful perked up cream sauce.

name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Goat Cheese and Bacon
ingredients:
3 strips Thick Cut Bacon, Diced
½ whole Large Yellow Onion Roughly Chopped
2 cloves Garlic, Roughly Chopped
1 dash Salt And Pepper, to taste
2-½ cups Chicken Or Vegetable Stock
1-½ cup Roasted Butternut Squash Puree
4 ounces, weight Goat Cheese Plus Extra For Garnish
½ cups Milk (I Used 1%)
¼ cups Fresh Parsley Leaves, For Garnish (optional)
description: This roasted butternut squash soup with goat cheese and bacon is the perfect dinner on a cold winter night!

name: Cinnamon Swirl Bagels with Cream Cheese
ingredients:
8 ounces, weight FOR THE CREAM CHEESE:
¼ cups Cream Cheese, Softened To Room Temperature
2 Tablespoons Walnuts, Crushed
2 Tablespoons Honey
½ teaspoons Brown Sugar
¼ teaspoons Vanilla
1 pinch Cinnamon
4 cups Salt, Or More To Taste (balances Out The Sweetness)
3 Tablespoons FOR THE BAGELS:
1 teaspoon Bread Flour
2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
1 package Salt
1-¼ cup Vegetable Oil
⅓ cups (1/4 Oz. Size) Instant Dry Active Yeast
1 Tablespoon Water
4 cups FOR THE SWIRL:
¼ cups Sugar
description: Cinnamon swirl bagels with honey walnut cream cheese. Why wouldn’t you want to wake up to freshly baked bagels every morning?

name: Slow Cooker Thai Yellow Curry
ingredients:
2 cups Crinkle Cut Carrots (or Peeled And Chopped Into ½ Inch Rounds)
2  Medium Yukon Gold Potatoes, Diced Into Small Pieces
1  Medium Sweet Onion, Chopped Fine
1  Small Orange Pepper, Chopped Fine
15 ounces, fluid Light Coconut Milk
1 cup Golden Raisins
1 cup Peas
¾ cups Vegetable Broth
3 cloves Garlic, Minced
2 Tablespoons Nutritional Yeast (optional)
1 Tablespoon Fresh Ginger, Minced
1 stalk Lemongrass, Inner Core, Chopped (about 1 Teaspoon)
1 teaspoon Garam Masala
1 teaspoon Turmeric
1 teaspoon Coriander
½ teaspoons Cumin
½ teaspoons Ground Sea Salt
description: Thai yellow curry with coconut milk and golden raisins. Super healthy and vegan!

name: Spanish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
ingredients:
1-½ pound FOR THE MEATBALLS:
1 sprig Ground Beef
1 clove Parsley, Chopped
1  Garlic, Finely Chopped
¾ cups Egg, Beaten
3 Tablespoons Fresh Bread Crumbs
½ teaspoons White Wine
⅓ cups Salt
1-¼ cup All-purpose Flour
4 Tablespoons Sunflower Oil, Or Vegetable Oil For Frying
⅓ cups FOR THE SAUCE:
2  Olive Oil
2-½ cups Onion, Chopped
1 pinch Ripe Tomatoes, Chopped (Or Sub One 15 Oz. Can Of Diced Tomatoes For The 2 Fresh Ones)
½ cups Water (for The Sauce)
description: Albóndigas en Salsa Tomate. Spanish-style meatballs served in a rich tomato and saffron sauce.

name: Baked Garlic Green Beans
ingredients:
4 cups Green Beans, Cleaned And Snipped
3 Tablespoons Olive Oil
2 Tablespoons Diced Garlic
1 pinch Sea Salt
description: Easy, simple baked green beans. Giving them a little bath in olive oil brings out so much delicious flavor. It’s a winner.

name: Blood Orange Mimosa
ingredients:
1 cup Chilled Blood Orange Juice Or Italian Blood Orange Soda
¼ cups Lime Juice
1 cup Chilled Ginger Ale
½ cups Chilled White Sparkling Wine (i.e. Prosecco)
1 cup Ice
¼ cups Salt
3 whole Lime Wedges
description: A fresh sparkling Mimosa made with blood orange juice, ginger ale and a touch of white sparkling wine.

name: Minty Lime and Pineapple Sangria
ingredients:
20 leaves Fresh Mint, Washed
4  Limes, Washed And Sliced Thin
1  Lemon, Washed And Sliced Thin
¼ cups Granulated Sugar
1  Small Pineapple, Peeled, Cored And Cut Into 1-inch Chunks
½ cups White Rum
4 cups Lemon/Lime Soda
¾ cups Pineapple Juice
1 bottle (750 Ml Size) Dry White Wine (I Used Pinot Grigio)
description: Mint and lime create the perfect level of ‘refreshing’ in this dangerously delicious sangria!

name: Mini Cinnamon Sugar Monkey Bread
ingredients:
¼ cups White Sugar
2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
¼ teaspoons Cinnamon
1 can (8 Oz. Size) Refrigerated Buttermilk Biscuits
4 Tablespoons Butter
4 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
2 Tablespoons Cream Cheese
½ cups Powdered Sugar
description: If you love monkey bread but don’t love the work involved, try this version using individual ramekins and refrigerated biscuit dough. They are sweet and cinnamony and just as good as a traditional homemade bundt pan variety, without all the work or guilt!

name: Tempura Shrimp with Honey Mustard Dipping Sauce
ingredients:
¼ cups FOR THE HONEY MUSTARD DIPPING SAUCE:
1 Tablespoon Dijon Mustard
3 Tablespoons Yellow Prepared Mustard
12  Honey
3 teaspoons FOR THE TEMPURA SHRIMP:
¼ cups Raw Shrimp (Peeled, Tails-On, Deveined)
1  Sifted Corn Starch
3 Tablespoons Ice Cold Water
1 cup Egg, Beaten
description: Quick and easy and ever so delish to eat.

name: Curried Cauliflower
ingredients:
1 head Cauliflower
2 teaspoons Curry Powder
1 teaspoon Cumin
1 teaspoon Ground Coriander
¼ teaspoons Turmeric
1 whole Lemon, Zested And Juiced
¼ cups Olive Oil
½ teaspoons Kosher Salt
¼ teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper
2 Tablespoons Chopped Fresh Cilantro
description: Easy and delicious, this flavorful and healthy cauliflower recipe is a delectable change of pace.

name: Green Mint Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup Spinach
½ cups Kale
½ cups Frozen Mango
½ cups Water
¼ cups Almond Milk (or Coconut Milk, Water, Juice, Etc.)
5 leaves Mint, More Or Less To Taste
description: Green smoothies doesn’t have to taste green. This Green Mint Smoothie is refreshing, sweet and has a delicious mint flavour.

name: Orange Marmalade and Raspberry Smoothie
ingredients:
1 cup Fresh Or Frozen Raspberries
1 cup Ice Cubes
¾ cups Orange Juice
¼ cups Plain Nonfat Greek Yogurt
1 Tablespoon Orange Marmalade
1 leaf Kale (Medium Size)
1 teaspoon Flax Seed
1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract
1 Tablespoon Honey, Or To Taste
description: A light sweet treat made with extra vanilla that has a hint of 50/50 bar flavor.

name: Stuffed Amaretto Glazed Chicken Breasts
ingredients:

1 Tablespoon FOR THE BROWNED BEEF:

1 Tablespoon 80% Lean Ground Chuck Beef

3 whole Blood Oranges, Half For Salad And Half For Dressing
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
1 Tablespoon Balsamic Vinegar

2 Tablespoons Minced Shallots

¼ cups Spinach And/or Mixed Greens Or As Desired

1 Tablespoon Large Egg Yolks
2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice
½ teaspoons Water + More As Needed
1-¾ cup Paprika

4 Tablespoons Eggs
½ teaspoons Whole Milk
¼ cups Water

name: Italian-Style Salisbury Steaks
ingredients:
1 whole Large Egg
1 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce
⅔ cups Finely Chopped Onion
2 cloves Garlic, Finely Minced
1 teaspoon Onion Powder
½ teaspoons Garlic Powder
½ teaspoons Black Pepper
½ cups Seasoned Bread Crumbs
2 Tablespoons (heaping) Grated Parmesan Cheese

½ teaspoons Dried Italian Seasoning

name: Italian Nachos
ingredients:
½ whole FOR THE ROASTED PEPPERS:
½ whole Red Bell Pepper
1 Tablespoon Green Bell Pepper
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil, To Drizzle Over Peppers
½ cups FOR THE HOMEMADE PARMESAN CHEESE SAUCE:
2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter
2 cups All-purpose Flour
½ cups Milk (I Used 1%)
1 Tablespoon Parmesan Cheese
1 Tablespoon FOR THE NACHOS:
description: A fun twist on the original. These Italian Nachos are loaded with a homemade Parmesan cheese sauce, spicy Italian sausage and roasted bell peppers.

name: Chicken Piccata with Orange Beer Glaze
ingredients:
¼ cups All-purpose Flour
¼ teaspoons Ground Black Pepper
2  Skinless And Boneless Chicken Breasts, Butterflied
1-½ teaspoon Butter
1-½ teaspoon Vegetable Oil
⅓ cups Orange Juice
⅓ cups Wheat Beer (I Used Hoegaarden)
1-½ teaspoon Orange Zest
2 Tablespoons Capers
2 Tablespoons Flat-leaf Parsley, Chopped

name: Spinach Potato Cakes with Parmesan
ingredients:
1-½ pound Yellow Potatoes
4 cups Fresh, Raw Spinach
2 Tablespoons Water
½ cups Diced Green Onion
1 cup Fresh Coarsely Grated Parmesan Cheese
1 whole Egg
¼ teaspoons Paprika
⅓ teaspoons Salt
⅛ teaspoons Black Pepper
1 Tablespoon Olive Oil
description: This recipe for Spinach Potato Cakes with Parmesan is cheesy and savory. It’s the product of much experimentation with the purpose of perfecting a delicious potato cake!

name: Chocolate Pudding Pie with Pretzel Crust and Peanut Butter Whipped Cream
ingredients:
1-½ cup Finely Crushed Pretzels (gluten-free If Desired), See Note
⅓ cups Brown Sugar
½ cups Unsalted Butter, melted
1 cup Heavy Whipping Cream, Very Cold
2 Tablespoons Creamy Peanut Butter
3 Tablespoons Powdered Sugar
½ teaspoons Vanilla Extract
2 cups Prepared Chocolate Pudding
description: A chocolate pudding pie with a gluten-free salty-sweet crunchy pretzel crust and a light and fluffy peanut butter whipped cream.

name: Crimson Cocktail
ingredients:
2 whole Strawberries
1-½ ounce, fluid Salted Caramel Vodka
½ cups Honey Simple Syrup
description: A blend of honey simple syrup, muddled strawberries, and salted caramel vodka.

name: Chocolate Mint Milkshake
ingredients:
5  Chocolate Sandwich Cookies
¼ cups Chocolate Chips
9 drops Green Food Coloring
1-¼ cup Milk
¼ teaspoons Mint Extract
5 cups Ice Cream
description: In honor of Saint Patrick’s Day this year, I came up with a chocolate and mint milkshake recipe. I added food coloring to make it green, but it didn’t turn out as green as I’d hoped. But trust me, this shake is really good! Like the name says, it’s chocolaty and minty. It’s the perfect drink to have in the spring or in the summer!

name: Chicken Broccolini with Mustard Cream Sauce
ingredients:
2 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts
1 bunch Broccolini (steamed For 1 To 2 Minute If Preferred)
⅓ cups All-purpose Flour
2 whole Large Eggs
2 Tablespoons Milk
¾ cups Seasoned Breadcrumbs
1 whole 1 Half Stick (1/4 Cup) Land O Lakes® Butter With Olive Oil & Sea Salt
3 cloves Garlic, Minced (about 1 Tablespoon)
¼ cups Brandy Or White Wine (can Use Chicken Broth As A Substitute)

1-½ teaspoon Grainy Brown Mustard
⅓ cups Chicken Broth, Plus More If Needed For Thinning
⅓ cups Heavy Cream
description: Scrumptious breaded chicken with beautiful broccolini inside, topped with a creamy brandy mustard sauce. Divine!

name: Wedge Salad with Blue Cheese Dressing
ingredients:
½ cups Heavy Cream
1 Tablespoon White Vinegar
1 teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce
¼ cups Blue Cheese Crumbles, Plus More For Sprinkling
1 teaspoon Garlic Powder
1 cup Cherry Tomatoes, Halved
3 ounces, weight Diced Pancetta
1 head (Large Size) Iceberg Lettuce, Cored And Cut Into 6 Wedges
2 whole Scallions, Thinly Sliced

description: A restaurant classic!

name: Chex Mix Treats
ingredients:
4 cups Sweet ‘n Salty Chex Mix
4 Tablespoons Butter
5 cups Mini Marshmallows
description: These Chex Mix Treats are crunchy, salty, sweet and loaded with gooey marshmallows.

name: Raw Beet Daikon Radish Soup
ingredients:
4 whole Beets
1 whole Cucumber
1 whole Daikon Radish
5 Tablespoons Olive Oil
4 Tablespoons Raw Apple Cider Vinegar
1 cup Filtered Water
3 cloves Garlic

1 teaspoon Minced Fresh Ginger
1 pinch Smoked Serrano Sea Salt Plus More For Garnish
description: Farm fresh beets and daikon radishes combined with cool cucumber are the base for this wonderful and invigorating raw cold soup.

name: Lemon and Passion Fruit Cupcakes
ingredients:
1 stick FOR THE CUPCAKES:
1 cup Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
1  White Sugar
2  Medium-sized Lemon, Zested
½ teaspoons Large Eggs
1-½ cup Vanilla Extract
1 pinch All-purpose Flour
2 teaspoons Salt
½ cups Baking Powder

2-½ cups FOR THE FROSTING:
1  Unsalted Butter, At Room Temperature
2 Tablespoons Powdered Sugar, Sifted Or More As Needed
description: These Lemon and Passion Fruit Cupcakes are light and delicate and pack a real flavour punch. Tender lemon cupcakes, with passion fruit coulis inside the cake and on top of the frosting. The perfect cupcakes to welcome Spring!

name: Blackberry Cheesecake Bars with Shortbread Crust
ingredients:
6 ounces, weight FOR THE BLACKBERRY SAUCE:
¼ cups Fresh Blackberries
¼ cups Sugar
2 drops Water
¾ cups Vanilla Extract

¾ cups Salt

1 teaspoon Softened Cream Cheese
description: Buttery crust, topped with a luscious cheesecake layer with a sweet blackberry sauce swirled into it. Quick to make, tastes delicious and has great flavor. One slice is not enough!

name: Pho-Style Chicken Stock

2 whole Onions
1 piece (3 In. Size) Fresh Ginger
2 pounds Chicken Thighs
1-½ pound Chicken Drumsticks
4 quarts Water
1 Tablespoon Salt
4 Tablespoons Fish Sauce

½ sticks Cinnamon

6 whole Hard Boiled Eggs, Cooled, Peeled

¼ cups Cilantro, Finely Chopped
1 Tablespoon Chives, Finely Chopped

1 whole FOR THE MAYO:
½ cups Avocado, Cut And Peeled

3 strips Lime, Juiced
2 slices Salt And Pepper, to taste

description: Sometimes all you need is a club sandwich with some jazzed up mayo to make you feel perfectly happy. The trick is all in your ingredients.

ingredients:
5 ounces, weight Goat Cheese, Softened
¼ cups Heavy Cream
1 pinch Dried Thyme
2 teaspoons Fresh Italian Parsley, Chopped Finely
1 pinch Salt
1 pinch Freshly Ground Black Pepper
8 ounces, weight Parmigiano-Reggiano, Grated
description: These Frico Cups with Herbed Goat Cheese Mousse are the perfect appetizer for any gathering.

name: Corned Beef Hash with Dijon Mustard Cream Sauce
ingredients:
2 Tablespoons FOR THE HASH:
2 cups Olive Oil Or Fat Of Your Choice
2 cups Leftover Cooked Corned Beef, Chopped

1-½ cup Dry Conventional Green Or Brown Lentils, Rinsed

1 leaf Dried Bay Leaf

or
